versions.changelog:
- Updated description to highlight You.com primary routing with automatic Exa fallback and no search-provider API key needed.
- Expanded user instructions with clearer "Use when," "Why install," and "When NOT to use" sections.
- Clarified that only a buyer’s own x402 wallet/client is required—no new account setup necessary.
- Provided a streamlined, concise minimal invocation example.
- Improved documentation of endpoint URLs, call flow, and integration details.

Improve truthful discovery text for agent web search, web research, x402, pay-per-call, paid API, and Base USDC. Update the published ClawHub install instructions. Endpoint, $0.012 price, behavior, and X-Jarvis-Client attribution remain unchanged.

Initial release of jarvis-a2a-search-buyer skill.

- Enables users with an x402-capable Base/USDC wallet to purchase one real-time web search from the Jarvis A2A Router.
- Fixed price: 0.012 USDC on the Base network.
- Designed for genuine public-web search tasks only; prohibits self-tests, probes, or synthetic traffic.
- No wallet custody, no refunds, and strict commercial/payment terms.
- Detailed step-by-step integration and call flow provided for secure transaction and result handling.
